svg.text: One-sensor direct test — Sensor 1 only (no rails except the 3.3 V wire)
Drawn for YOUR board: ESP32 with USB at the top. Use the pin labels printed on the ESP32.
purple wire: 3V3 → left + rail (you already have this)
VCC → hole next to the purple wire
Same row = any of the free holes
left of that pin, in that row.
